title: Bears Running Back Kyle Monangai Suffers Knee Injury at Practice
summary: Chicago Bears running back Kyle Monangai exited practice early on Tuesday due to an apparent right knee injury. The severity of the injury is currently unknown. An NFL insider has provided an update on the situation, though details were not specified in the coverage. Monangai is a player for the Chicago Bears.
summary_points: Chicago Bears running back Kyle Monangai left practice early.
The departure was due to an apparent right knee injury.
The specific severity of the injury has not been disclosed.
An NFL insider has offered an update on Monangai's knee injury.
